content.summary: Reviewed monitoring fingerprints, append-only successor results, bounded retries and challenge evidence classes. Tests distinguish dependency changes from unrelated controls and method/schema changes from unchanged source hashes.
findings: Monitor ticks are explicit commands suitable for a scheduler; no unattended daemon or bank SLA is implied.
Reservations persist before investigation; crashes and failures cannot refund retry count.
Text-change challenges establish edit sensitivity only; original Java mutants establish behavioral sensitivity. Neither measures English accuracy.
Unchanged controls reuse only exact control/source/method/fact-schema fingerprints.
Live source-fidelity challenge execution is integrated in the final pilot rather than claimed from a text-difference test.
Every callback result is denied release authority; old result files remain immutable.
